notes: Created BDD implementation plan for mobile bottom sheet adjustments based on change request 2026-07-26-01-mobile-bottom-sheet-adjustments.md. Plan covers 2 phases: (1) Remove crop preview canvas from Edit bottom sheet — remove bsCropPreviewCanvas from template, unwire from lifecycle/methods/renderer DOM ID configs, update 6 unit tests (BS-ADJ-01 through BS-ADJ-06), 5 E2E tests (BS-ADJ-E2E-01 through BS-ADJ-E2E-05). Crop info readout and Reset Crop button retained as standard .detail-section. (2) Reorder Images bottom sheet — move Layout Controls above Image Library, add sticky section headers with new CSS (.bottom-sheet-section-header), 3 CSS validation tests, 3 DOM structure tests, 5 E2E tests. Consulted @world-review for UX perspective (touch target justification, vertical space concern with 5 controls, ARIA live regions for crop readout, sticky header pattern, DOM order for screen readers). Key discovery: CropInteraction already supports single canvas ID (normalizes string to array), no JS changes needed in interaction module. createCropPreviewRenderer already guards hidden canvases — removing wiring eliminates DOM lookup overhead entirely.
